packageRules.description: GitHub Actions version bumps touch .github/workflows/**, which our agents never edit. Renovate's own app install has the `workflow` permission, and it waits for the required checks (checks, workflows from pr-checks.yml) before merging, so Renovate merges these itself.

The runtime image is rebuilt every week by ACT-lg-baseimg and published as <python>-<YYYYMMDD>. That tag is not semver: the regex tells Renovate how to order it, so a newer build date is a pull request. The agent pipeline builds the image from it, tests it and merges it.
The build stage (python) and the runtime (lgirardi/lg-python) must stay on the same Python minor: the virtualenv is tied to the interpreter. One pull request moves both.
